profile.name: 通用 GPIO PWM 输出器件
profile.description: 一种通过 GPIO 引脚输出脉宽调制信号的通用物理输出器件/通道，可在实验中调节占空比与频率，用于驱动 LED 亮度、蜂鸣器强度、执行器功率或其他支持 PWM 的负载。
profile.description_en: A generic physical GPIO output device/channel that emits pulse-width modulation signals. It is used in experiments to adjust duty cycle and frequency for driving LED brightness, buzzer intensity, actuator power, or other PWM-capable loads.
